        private static void PopulateFromJsonBody(System.ReadOnlySpan<byte> bodyBytes, global::TestNamespace.UpdateItemCommand operation)
        {
            var reader = new System.Text.Json.Utf8JsonReader(bodyBytes);
            if (!reader.Read() || reader.TokenType != System.Text.Json.JsonTokenType.StartObject) return;

            while (reader.Read())

                if (reader.TokenType == System.Text.Json.JsonTokenType.EndObject) break;
                if (reader.TokenType != System.Text.Json.JsonTokenType.PropertyName) continue;

                    reader.Read();
                    operation.Description = reader.GetString();
                }
                else
                {
                    reader.Skip();
                }
            }
